update.releaseNotes:
v5.10.6 - Career-end harvest report and Borrow Card reliability fixes
Fixed ----- - The Career Runs harvest report ("Sparks:" line) could show raw, sometimes garbled OCR text from the in-run spark picks instead of the actual harvested factors, whenever no "CareerComplete" skill plan was configured. The skill list screen (needed for the harvest scanner to read factors) was only being opened when that unrelated skill plan was enabled, so the harvest scanner silently found nothing and the archive fell back to the raw OCR text. The skill list screen is now also opened whenever the harvest report feature itself is enabled. - Auto-borrowing a friend's support card could tap the "Remove" button (shown above the friend list whenever a card is already borrowed from a prior run) instead of the intended friend's card, since the generic list-entry scanner could pick it up as if it were a normal row. Rows whose text reads "Remove" are now skipped before matching against your preferred support cards. - If the Borrow Card picker was ever left open (from the issue above or any other detection hiccup), the bot had no way to recognize or recover from it and would get stuck on that screen indefinitely. It's now registered as a recognized screen so the per-turn dialog check can close it automatically.
